re_estimate.basis: Estimates, not measurements. Two-agent Git times from #27 (Claude Code 2.1.287): 36.8-39.3 s rust-errors, 96.0-106.0 s go-page, 61.3-79.6 s go-relationships. One agent: up to twice the two-agent maximum on those three; #181's calibration wall time up to 1.5x on go-indep (124-186 s go-indep-2, 244-396 s go-indep-4); two agents on go-indep from half of one agent up to no gain. Per run, up to a 60 s drain and a 27 s gap (#27 ledgers). Per invocation, 159 s preparation (#110), a 425-590 s gate (#122, #27 ledgers) and about 40 s verify. Contingency: one 1,800 s timeout with its replacement, and one re-invocation.
